messageHandlers.script:
system.perspective.sendMessage("resetTable", payload={})
	
	listCustom = [
		"answers"
	]
	
	for path in listCustom:
		self.parent.parent.getChild("FlexContainer3").refreshBinding("custom.{}".format(path))
		self.parent.parent.getChild("FlexContainer1").refreshBinding("custom.{}".format(path))
		self.parent.parent.getChild("FlexContainer2").refreshBinding("custom.{}".format(path))
		self.parent.parent.getChild("FlexContainer4").refreshBinding("custom.{}".format(path))
		self.parent.parent.getChild("FlexContainer5").refreshBinding("custom.{}".format(path))
	
	
	listCustom = [
		"answers.condiciones",
		"answers.probador1",
		"answers.soldador",
		"answers.probador2",
		"answers.condiciones30"
		
	]
	for path in listCustom:
		self.view.refreshBinding("custom.{}".format(path))
		
	answerCond = self.view.custom.answers.condiciones
	answerProb1 = self.view.custom.answers.probador1
	answerSol = self.view.custom.answers.soldador
	answerProb2 = self.view.custom.answers.probador2
	answerCond30 = self.view.custom.answers.condiciones30
	
	papoID = self.view.params.papoID
	user = self.session.props.auth.user.userName
	workstationNodeID = self.view.params.workstationnodeID
	workstationID = self.view.params.workstationID
	nodeID = self.view.params.nodeID
	
	
	now = system.date.now()
	
	from java.lang import String

	query = """
		SELECT TOP 1 RegisterCode
		FROM registerhistory
		WHERE WorkstationNodeID=? AND PapoID=?
		ORDER BY RegisterCode DESC
	"""


	result = system.db.runPrepQuery(query, [workstationNodeID,papoID], "papo_db")
	
	regCode = result.getValueAt(0,0)
	
	query = """
		SELECT TOP 1 Status
		FROM registerhistory
		WHERE WorkstationNodeID=? AND PapoID=?
		ORDER BY Timestamp DESC
	"""


	result = system.db.runPrepQuery(query, [workstationNodeID,papoID], "papo_db")
	
	status = result.getValueAt(0,0)
	
	registerTypeID = self.view.custom.registerTypeID

	def insert_answer(registerTypeID, answerJson, regCode):
		if not answerJson:
			return
		query = """
			INSERT INTO registerhistory (
				[Timestamp],
				DataAnswer,
				Status,
				PapoID,
				RegisterTypeID,
				[User],
				WorkstationNodeID,
				NodeID,
				WorkstationID,
				RegisterCode
			)
			VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ? ,?)
		"""
		
		# ⚠️ Aseguramos que sea String plano
		data_answer_str = String(answerJson)
		
		params = [
			now,
			data_answer_str,
			status,
			papoID,
			registerTypeID,
			user,
			workstationNodeID,
			nodeID,
			workstationID,
			regCode
		]
		system.db.runPrepUpdate(query, params, "papo_db")
	
	# --- Insertar directo los tres JSON ---
	insert_answer(registerTypeID, system.util.jsonEncode(answerCond), regCode)
	insert_answer(registerTypeID, system.util.jsonEncode(answerProb1), regCode)
	insert_answer(registerTypeID, system.util.jsonEncode(answerSol), regCode)  
	insert_answer(registerTypeID, system.util.jsonEncode(answerProb2), regCode)  
	insert_answer(registerTypeID, system.util.jsonEncode(answerCond30), regCode)  
	
	
	system.perspective.sendMessage("refreshTable",   {"estado": True},  scope="session")
	system.perspective.sendMessage("closeEmbeded",   {"estado": False}, scope="session")
	system.perspective.sendMessage("refreshPeriodic",{"min": 0},        scope="session")
	system.perspective.sendMessage("refreshPreviewTable", payload=[], scope="session")
